tools.name: list_blogs
tools.description: List the authenticated user's accessible blogs so later tool calls can target the right blogId.

tools.name: get_blog
tools.description: Get a single blog by ID, including settings like subdomain, domain, logo, and metadata.

tools.name: list_blog_members
tools.description: List blog members who can be assigned as post authors. Use a member id as authorId in create_post or update_post.

tools.name: create_blog
tools.description: Create a new blog. Subdomain is auto-generated from the name. Requires account-level OAuth or a user-scoped API key.

tools.name: update_blog
tools.description: Update blog settings including name, subdomain, description, and logo. Requires owner or admin access.

tools.name: delete_blog
tools.description: Delete a blog by ID. Only the blog owner can delete. Active subscriptions are cancelled automatically.

tools.name: get_blog_metadata
tools.description: Get custom metadata for a blog (SEO fields, themeId, etc.). Does not include themeSettings values.

tools.name: update_blog_metadata
tools.description: Merge custom metadata into a blog. Pass only the keys you want to add or update. Theme changes use the dedicated theme tools.

tools.name: update_blog_domain
tools.description: Configure or remove a blog's custom domain. Use domain only for custom domains (requires CNAME/A DNS). Use domain + domain_slug for subdirectory hosting (requires TXT DNS verification). Pass an empty domain string to remove the domain.

tools.name: list_available_themes
tools.description: List built-in themes available for a blog and show which theme is currently active.

tools.name: get_theme_settings
tools.description: Get theme settings schema and current values for a blog's active theme.

tools.name: update_theme_settings
tools.description: Update one or more theme setting values for a blog. Unspecified values are preserved. Use get_theme_settings first to discover valid keys.

tools.name: switch_theme
tools.description: Switch a blog to a different built-in theme or to custom if theme files exist.

tools.name: list_theme_files
tools.description: List the theme file tree for a blog (layouts, templates, assets, etc.).

tools.name: get_theme_file
tools.description: Read a theme file by path (e.g. layouts/theme.liquid). Falls back to the active built-in theme when no custom copy exists.

tools.name: update_theme_file
tools.description: Create or update a theme file. Requires a Pro subscription. Copies the built-in theme first if no custom files exist yet.

tools.name: delete_theme_file
tools.description: Delete a custom theme file from a blog. Requires a Pro subscription. Cannot delete built-in-only files.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload an image to a blog. Use the returned path as the image value when creating or updating a post, page, or blog.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List blog posts with pagination, filtering, and sorting by status, collection, tag, author, or date.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get a single blog post by ID.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a new blog post with title, HTML content, author, collection, tags, metadata, slug, image, and publishing options. status=published makes the post live. collection_id is optional; omit it to use the empty-slug default Posts collection. If that default does not exist, provide collection_id (ca

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Update any editable field on an existing blog post, including its author.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Delete a blog post by ID.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List static pages with pagination, filtering, and sorting.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get a single static page by ID.

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new static page with title, HTML body, metadata, slug, image, and status. status=published makes the page live.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update any editable field on an existing static page.

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a static page by ID.

tools.name: list_redirects
tools.description: List redirects for a blog with search, status, type, and pagination filters. Requires owner or admin access through account-level OAuth or a user-scoped API key.

tools.name: get_redirect
tools.description: Get a single redirect by ID. Requires owner or admin access through account-level OAuth or a user-scoped API key.

tools.name: create_redirect
tools.description: Create a redirect for a blog. Requires owner or admin access through account-level OAuth or a user-scoped API key.

tools.name: update_redirect
tools.description: Update a redirect source, destination, status code, or active state. Requires owner or admin access through account-level OAuth or a user-scoped API key.

tools.name: delete_redirect
tools.description: Delete a redirect by ID. Requires owner or admin access through account-level OAuth or a user-scoped API key.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a new blog tag by name. Requires permission to manage taxonomy.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List blog tags with optional case-insensitive search filtering.

tools.name: update_tag
tools.description: Rename a blog tag.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Delete a blog tag by ID.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List all collections for a blog.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get a single collection by ID, including its post count.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a new collection with name, slug, and optional description.

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Update an existing collection's name, slug, or description.

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Delete a collection by ID and optionally reassign its posts to another collection.

tools.name: list_content_revisions
tools.description: List the saved revision history for a post or page. Returns revision metadata without full snapshots.

tools.name: get_content_revision
tools.description: Get one saved post or page revision, including its complete content snapshot.

tools.name: list_content_reviews
tools.description: List content review requests for a blog, filtered by status.

tools.name: get_latest_content_review
tools.description: Get the latest review associated with the newest saved revision of a post or page.

tools.name: submit_content_review
tools.description: Submit the latest saved revision of a draft post or page for review.

tools.name: decide_content_review
tools.description: Approve a pending content review or request changes. Approving a staged update to published content applies that revision.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_blog_members, list_posts, get_post, get_collection, list_content_revisions, get_content_revision, list_content_reviews, get_latest_content_review · Private data: create_blog, switch_theme, list_theme_files, get_theme_file, update_theme_file, delete_theme_file, list_redirects, get_redirect, create_redirect, update_redirect, delete_redirect · Public sink: list_blog_members, upload_image, get_post, create_post, update_post, delete_post, get_collection, list_content_revisions, get_content_revision, get_latest_content_review, submit_content_review · Destructive: delete_blog, update_blog_domain, delete_theme_file, delete_post, delete_page, delete_redirect, delete_tag, delete_collection.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_blog_members, list_posts, get_post, get_collection, list_content_revisions, get_content_revision, list_content_reviews, get_latest_content_review · Private data: create_blog, switch_theme, list_theme_files, get_theme_file, update_theme_file, delete_theme_file, list_redirects, get_redirect, create_redirect, update_redirect, delete_redirect · Public sink: list_blog_members, upload_image, get_post, create_post, update_post, delete_post, get_collection, list_content_revisions, get_content_revision, get_latest_content_review, submit_content_review · Destructive: delete_blog, update_blog_domain, delete_theme_file, delete_post, delete_page, delete_redirect, delete_tag, delete_collection

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
